title: High sensitivity terahertz metamaterial sensor for trace pesticide detection
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20530-20541
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01143D, Paper
Open Access

Fardin Ahmed, Md Ayenul Azim, Ahmed Zubair
A terahertz metamaterial sensor was engineered to detect trace amounts of pesticide with high sensitivity, demonstrating significant potential for food safety and environmental monitoring applications.
